name: When should I contact a motor vehicle accident lawyer after a car crash?
description: Contact a motor vehicle accident lawyer as soon as possible after a crash, especially if injured, to preserve evidence and protect your rights.

mainEntity.name: When should I contact a motor vehicle accident lawyer after a car crash?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is advisable to contact a motor vehicle accident lawyer as soon as possible after a crash, especially if you sustained injuries or there are complex circumstances. Early involvement allows the attorney to preserve critical evidence, guide you through the reporting process, and protect your rights from the outset. Delaying contact could complicate your case, as evidence may be lost or statutes of limitations could approach.
